spec = [("349943","mathdb-normalized-chunk-0007.jsonl",4282),

("360178","mathdb-normalized-chunk-0009.jsonl",4430)]
res=[]
for pid,chunk,ln in spec:
    p=os.path.join(CORP,chunk)
    raw=open(p,'rb').read()
    ch=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    lines=raw.split(b'\n')
    line=lines[ln-1]
    trailing = ln < len(lines)
    obj=json.loads(line.decode('utf-8'))
    st=obj['statement']
    token=json.dumps(st,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
    res.append({
      "id":pid,"chunk":chunk,"chunk_sha256":ch,"line_1based":ln,
      "raw_line_len":len(line),"raw_line_sha256":hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest(),
      "trailing_newline":trailing,
      "statement_token_sha256":hashlib.sha256(token.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
      "decoded_statement_len":len(st),"decoded_statement_sha256":hashlib.sha256(st.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
      "title":obj.get("title"),"status":obj.get("status"),
      "source_url":obj.get("source_url"),"source_name":obj.get("source_name"),
      "first_stated_year":obj.get("first_stated_year"),"solution_count":obj.get("solution_count"),
      "tags":obj.get("tags"),"statement":st})
print(json.dumps({"definitions":{"raw_line":"bytes of the JSONL line excluding its trailing newline","trailing_newline":"true iff the line is followed by a newline in the chunk file","statement_token":"json.dumps(statement, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'))","decoded_statement":"the statement string encoded UTF-8"},"corpus_dir":CORP,"count":len(res),"bindings":res},ensure_ascii=False,indent=1))
